title: WiseMind: Recontextualizing AI with a Knowledge-Guided, Theory-Informed Multi-Agent Framework for Instrumental and Humanistic Benefits
reasoning: The paper focuses on psychiatric differential diagnosis and empathy. It includes a section on 'Ethical Considerations' and evaluates 'ethical resilience' through adversarial audits targeting high-risk behaviors (like suicidal ideation), but it does not benchmark religion, morals, or ethical reasoning frameworks as defined by the criteria.
